english.title: Fail to comply with a duty imposed by regulation 11
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[the packer of packages of **(..SPECIFY CONTENTS OF PACKAGES..) marked with the E-mark and which you intended to export from the United Kingdom,]_
(B)_[a person who intended to import packages of **(..SPECIFY CONTENTS OF PACKAGES..) which were marked with the E-mark and which you intended to export from the United Kingdom to another member state, namely **(..SPECIFY STATE..),]_
(C)_[a person who intended to import packages of **(..SPECIFY CONTENTS OF PACKAGES..), to mark them with the E-mark and to export them from the United Kingdom to another member state, namely **(..SPECIFY STATE..),]_

failed to give to **(..SPECIFY AUTHORITY..), the local weights and measures authority for the area in which the

(D)_[packages were packed,]_
(E)_[place of intended import was situated,]_

a notice in accordance with regulation 11(2) of the Weights and Measures (Packaged Goods) Regulations 2006
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 15(2) and 18(1) of the Weights and Measures (Packaged Goods) Regulations 2006.

english.notes:
(i) See regulation 2 for definitions of 'E-mark' and 'package'
(ii) Regulation 10(4) provides that proceedings for an offence under these Regulations, other than an offence under regulation 16, shall not be instituted after the expiration of the period of twelve months beginning with the date when the offence was committed.
